guard: raw NATS transport liveness is epoch-safe and separate from full endpoint readiness
why: The deterministic status queues grade the exact nats.js lifecycle contract without timing a broker outage. The companion broker smoke separately proves real public disconnect and reconnect events reach these paths.
Core is rebuilt before each run and after every restore because connector-core resolves @cotal-ai/core through dist. Connector-core's agent source is imported relatively by the suite.
The full predicted kill sets, including every exclusion, are recorded in the suite header before this config is run.

mutations.name: old status iterators may overwrite the current connection epoch
mutations.expectRed: late disconnect and close from the OLD epoch are ignored after the replacement is current
mutations.cell: late disconnect and close from the OLD epoch are ignored after the replacement is current

mutations.name: disconnect status no longer produces a transport edge
mutations.find: this.emit("transport", { connected: false, server: s.server } satisfies TransportState);
mutations.expectRed: a NATS disconnect makes transport false WITHOUT flapping full-bind readiness
mutations.cell: a NATS disconnect makes transport false WITHOUT flapping full-bind readiness

mutations.name: reconnect status no longer restores transport
mutations.find: this.emit("transport", { connected: true, server: s.server } satisfies TransportState);
mutations.expectRed: the distinguishable NATS reconnect edge restores transport without another readiness event
mutations.cell: the distinguishable NATS reconnect edge restores transport without another readiness event

mutations.name: status watcher does not publish its explicit initial live state
mutations.find: this.emit("transport", { connected: true, server: nc.getServer() } satisfies TransportState);
mutations.expectRed: arming status publishes an explicit initial transport=true with the real server
mutations.cell: arming status publishes an explicit initial transport=true with the real server

mutations.name: MeshAgent forwards duplicate transport states
mutations.expectRed: a duplicate transport=false is idempotent at MeshAgent
mutations.cell: a duplicate transport=false is idempotent at MeshAgent

mutations.name: clean stop leaves full-bind readiness true
mutations.expectRed: MeshAgent.stop clears both readiness and transport locally
mutations.cell: MeshAgent.stop clears both readiness and transport locally

mutations.name: post-bind endpoint errors become stale connection issues again
mutations.expectRed: a post-bind endpoint error is logged but is NOT presented as the pre-bind connection issue
mutations.cell: a post-bind endpoint error is logged but is NOT presented as the pre-bind connection issue

mutations.name: a late transport edge can resurrect a stopped MeshAgent
mutations.replace: // Transport events are accepted even after stop.
mutations.expectRed: late endpoint events after stop cannot resurrect readiness or transport
mutations.cell: late endpoint events after stop cannot resurrect readiness or transport

mutations.name: a late readiness edge can resurrect a stopped MeshAgent
mutations.find:
// Same stop race as transport above: a late connectAndBind completion is not a new session.
      if (this.stopping) return;
mutations.replace: // Readiness events are accepted even after stop.
mutations.expectRed: late endpoint events after stop cannot resurrect readiness or transport
mutations.cell: late endpoint events after stop cannot resurrect readiness or transport
